notes.title: Morphies Law Remorphed Release Date
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34041627/07afa03f78c4cb5391ccedc382c3496b79100076.png[/img]

[h1]Morphies Law [strike]2.0[/strike] Remorphed is almost here![/h1]

We’re super excited to finally share the release date of [b]Morphies Law: Remorphed[/b] with everyone. On July 30th Remorphed will launch right here on Steam and will be available to all existing [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/morphies-law-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url] owners as a free update. 

Remorphed is everything you loved about Morphies Law, with none of the leftovers. It’s always been about the Mass, so let’s take a look at what you can expect later this month: 

[b]Features:[/b]
[list][*] The Morphies have 8 body parts that grow and shrink individually, and each body part has a direct effect on your actions. 
[*] Each body part has a unique Plugin to help you change your strategy. Unlock new Plugins to create brand new strategies.
[*] You can unlock weapon parts and combine them at will to make the perfect weapon for you! 
[*] Four mass-based game modes with different goals but with one thing in common: size always matters more than kills!
[*] Eight maps where each one has a unique mass-related feature that'll make it different from the rest! 
[*] Make your Morphie truly unique! You can choose from premade options, make your own custom ones and much more![/list]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YQ5iZRB0sPw&feature=youtu.be

We’re also really pleased to confirm that not only will Remorphed launch with [b]Dedicated Servers[/b], it will also support crossplay between [b]Steam and Nintendo Switch[/b]. ːsteamhappyː

[quote=Some guy at Morphie HQ]We’re extremely happy to be bringing our game to Steam and a newly updated version to the Switch. We believe that gamers will love the twist that we’ve added on to shooter combat and the extensive customization options we’ve put in the game.[/quote]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34041627/803f9f40492642c79790a7d065687f18f47e452d.png[/img]

[b]Beta Events & The Morphies Community[/b]

We’ve been running a number of beta testing events with our Community over on Discord. We want to take a moment to thank them all for their continued support and incredible feedback week after week. We’ve used this to fine-tune the game during the critical pre-release phase and without their support, our job would have been a lot harder. Thank you to everyone who took part in one or all the beta events, even if you’re not in Discord. 

If you haven’t already, join over 5000 other Morphies in the Official Morphies Law Discord below!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34041627/13aaf6e82bd4dc6a7caf59ff9c4c4c39d4b2daf6.png[/img]

Don’t forget to Wishlist Morphies Law Remorphed if you haven’t already, and help us spread the word. Enjoy the screenshots below and we’ll see you on [b]July 30th![/b]
